final: SELECT bp.player_id, SUM(bp.triple) AS total_triples FROM batting_postseason AS bp WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM batting_postseason AS ws WHERE ws.player_id = bp.player_id AND ws.league_id = 'NL' AND ws.round = 'WS') GROUP BY bp.player_id ORDER BY total_triples DESC NULLS LAST, bp.player_id LIMIT 10
